user_saw: On large agent fleets, Gateway health and status requests stalled or timed out during startup and post-ready model preparation.
summary: The fix shares immutable discovery data and configuration fingerprints across agents and yields to the event loop during model preparation so the Gateway can handle requests.
reasoning: The diffs show that #145190 added per-agent hashing of the full roster and plugin config, and #147405 added repeated activation-config hashing to the existing batch. An earlier large-roster fix documented a health-probe recovery on a different fixture, while #150223 measured its own changes against a baseline that already contained both hashing changes. The evidence identifies several contributors to the stalls and leaves the first failing revision undetermined.
